items.text: Puff your way through the week with 2g Dispo Tuesday! Every Tuesday in October, grab select 2g disposables for just $40 at Cape Cod Cannabis. Explore fresh flavors, revisit your favorites, and bring a little extra brightness to your fall routine. Tuesdays just became another reason we’re Always Worth the Trip! While supplies last!

Double the chocolate, double the delight! On Friday, October 16th only, pick up two Double Baked RSO chocolates for just $12.50 at Cape Cod Cannabis. Give your fall weekend a sweeter start with a one-day offer that’s Always Worth the Trip! Available October 16, 2026 only, while supplies last.

$12 Tuesday is back for one day only! On October 20, 2026, pick up Blackstone Valley Cannabis 3.5g flower for just $12 at Cape Cod Cannabis. Mark your calendar—this October offer is available only on 10/20/26, while supplies last!

Give your week a sweeter twist with Wax & Wana Wednesday! Every Wednesday in October, explore $20 1g concentrates and $25 Wana Gummies at Cape Cod Cannabis. From flavorful dabs to fruity bites, your midweek favorites are waiting. Make Wednesday Always Worth the Trip! Available every Wednesday in October, while supplies last.

Keep Sundays simple with Simpler Daze! Every Sunday in October, pick up two 28g Simpler Daze ounces from select participating strains for $140 at Cape Cod Cannabis—that’s $70 per ounce. Give your fall weekend a laid-back finish with Simpler Daze Sundays, Always Worth the Trip! Available every Sunday in October on select strains!

Eureka Disposables are even better together! For a limited time, mix and match select Eureka Disposables 2 for $40. Choose from a variety of flavors and stock up on your favorites while the offer lasts. Available while supplies last.
